Bug_Explanation: The static import of the inner class 'Inner' is using the non-canonical name 'a.Two.Inner' instead of the canonical name 'a.One.Inner'. This can lead to confusion as 'Inner' is actually a member of 'One', not 'Two'.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when the test case tries to use the non-canonical name 'Two.Inner' to import the inner class 'Inner'. This causes a ClassNotFoundException.
